comment: The X and Y position parameters carry the pad's own value and have no ParamWidget of their own (the XY pad is a single custom widget), so parameters 0 and 1 cannot be clicked and get no line. The offset knob is added after the range rescale, so the output can reach 10V with both at their extremes.
